posts.body: I've been looking at diaper disposal systems but would like some more input. I think individual bags per diaper are too much waste (feel bad about disposable diapers already!). What other options are there?
posts.body_with_quotes: I've been looking at diaper disposal systems but would like some more input. I think individual bags per diaper are too much waste (feel bad about disposable diapers already!). What other options are there?

posts.body:
We use the Nappy Safe which is like a diaper genie. You just dump the dirty diaper in the top and turn over the handle so it falls in the bin. I like it b/c you can use any type of plastic liner inside and don't have to buy specific ones. It's on the floor in the nursery and can hold a lot of nappies (maybe @ 10-12). 

http://www.kiddieskitchen.co.uk/store/shopexd.asp?id=473

posts.body: why do you need a system at all? we just threw our diapers into a trash in the guest bathroom and then made sure that this trash was emptied once a day.

posts.body: Same here. We just used an extra trash can that closed on the top and emptied it regularly. I didn't notice any bad smells around the house.

posts.body: i like our Nappy Safe b/c my older one cannot open it and it totally masks the smells. We dump ours @ every other day.
